title: Second affine moment derivative expression
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $r,c,t\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define the associated second-order expression as the expectation over $x\in\Omega$ of $r(r-1)c^2X(x)^2(1+ctX(x))^{r-2}$.
